name: ASCIIFlow
description: Touch-first offline ASCII UI prototyping editor with canvas-level paste menu.

localizedDescriptions.zh: 离线 ASCII UI 原型草稿工具：长按对象复制，长按空白画布粘贴。
localizedDescriptions.en: Offline full-screen ASCII UI prototype sketch editor with drag-to-create geometry, text, long-press object copy/paste/delete and locking, multi-object selection, secondary editing, undo/redo and import/export.
